description: Stem borers are insect pests whose larvae feed on plant stems and leaves. They are common in cereal crops such as maize, rice and sorghum. Larvae bore into stems and cause internal damage that reduces plant growth and productivity.
symptoms: Dead heart symptom in young plants
spread: Adult insects laying eggs on plant leaves

biological: Encourage parasitoid wasps and natural predators
chemical: Apply recommended insecticides when infestation levels are high
